connections.why: A recognised need is analysed and written up as a design brief and specification
The brief directs the research needed to understand constraints and users
Research findings feed the generation of realistic design ideas
Ideas are appraised so the best solution can be selected and planned
A planned solution is realised by preparing materials and choosing processes
The made outcome is tested and evaluated against the original specification
Evaluation feeds modifications back into the specification, closing the design loop
Sketching, drawing and modelling are the tools used to generate and record ideas
CAD lets designers generate and communicate 2D and 3D design ideas
Safe use of tools and machines underpins all making and realisation
Function, ergonomics and production method inform which solution is selected
Sustainable material choices shape practical design decisions
Awareness of social and economic impact frames sustainability responsibilities
The common control-systems model is developed in depth in Systems & Control
Common shaping, joining and finishing is specialised in Resistant Materials processes
Knowing material properties guides the correct preparation and shaping processes
Smart materials and composites extend the core study of plastics, woods and metals
The key content introduces structures studied in depth in this option
Levers and motion in the key content are developed fully in Mechanisms
Basic circuit concepts in the key content are extended in Electronics
General communication skills are formalised as graphic drawing conventions
Drawings are rendered and presented to convey ideas with impact
Developments and nets are realised when modelling and making graphic products
Core evaluation skills are applied when testing and evaluating the project
The coursework project applies the brief-writing skills taught in the core
The design brief is researched to produce a justified specification
The specification frames the range of ideas generated
A promising idea is selected and developed through modelling
The developed solution is detailed into working drawings and a production plan
The production plan guides the making of the final product
The finished product is tested and evaluated against its specification
